translations.idiomatic: He twice served as acting prefect of Daozhou and also concurrently as acting magistrate of Xintian, and everywhere he left benevolent rule behind.

sentences.zh: 以足疾請告，時大吏已疏調輝祖善化，又檄鄰邑獄，因足疾久不赴，疑其規避，奪職。

translations.literal: He requested leave because of foot ailment; at the time his superiors had already memorialized to transfer him to Shanhua, and ordered him to handle a case in a neighboring county; because he long failed to go on account of his illness they suspected evasion and stripped him of office.
translations.idiomatic: He asked leave on account of foot ailment. By then his superiors had already memorialized to transfer him to Shanhua and ordered him to take up a case in a neighboring county. Because he long failed to go on account of his illness, they suspected evasion and removed him from office.

sentences.zh: 歸里，閉戶讀書，不問外事。

translations.literal: He returned home, shut his doors to study, and paid no heed to outside affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He went home, shut his doors to read, and paid no attention to outside affairs.

sentences.zh: 值紹興西江塘圮，巡撫吉慶強輝祖任其事，帑節工堅，時稱之。

translations.literal: When the Xijiang embankment at Shaoxing collapsed, Provincial Governor Ji Qing pressed Huizu to take charge; the budget was economical and the work solid, and people praised it at the time.
translations.idiomatic: When the Xijiang embankment at Shaoxing collapsed, Provincial Governor Ji Qing pressed Huizu to take charge. The budget was tight and the work sound, and people praised it at the time.

sentences.zh: 舉孝廉方正，固辭免。

translations.literal: Recommended as Filial and Incorrupt, he firmly declined.
translations.idiomatic: Recommended as Filial and Incorrupt, he firmly refused.

sentences.zh: 輝祖少尚氣節，及為令，持論挺特不屈，而從善如轉圜。

translations.literal: Huizu had prized integrity since youth; as magistrate his opinions were upright and unyielding, yet he accepted good counsel as easily as a wheel turns.
translations.idiomatic: Huizu had honored integrity since youth. As magistrate his views were upright and unyielding, yet he took good advice as easily as a wheel turns.

sentences.zh: 所著學治臆說、佐治藥言，皆閱歷有得之言，為言治者所宗。

translations.literal: His works Xuezhi Yishuo and Zuozhi Yaoyan were all words earned through experience, and those who discourse on governance look to them as authority.
translations.idiomatic: His works Xuezhi Yishuo and Zuozhi Yaoyan were hard-won words drawn from experience, and those who speak of governing still look to them as guides.

sentences.zh: 初通籍在京師待銓，主同郡茹敦和，論治最契。

translations.literal: When he first entered the registers and waited in the capital for appointment, he lodged with Ru Dunhe of the same prefecture; their discussions on governance found the deepest accord.
translations.idiomatic: When he first entered the official rolls and waited in the capital for appointment, he stayed with Ru Dunhe, a fellow townsman; their talk of governance found the deepest accord.

sentences.zh: 同時硃休度並以慈惠稱。

translations.literal: At the same time Zhu Xiudu was also renowned for kindness and benevolence.
translations.idiomatic: At the same time Zhu Xiudu was also known for kindness and benevolence.

sentences.zh: 敦和，字三樵，浙江會稽人。

translations.literal: Dunhe, courtesy name Sanqiao, was a native of Kuaiji in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Dunhe, courtesy name Sanqiao, was from Kuaiji in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 初嗣婦翁李為子，佔籍廣東。

translations.literal: At first he was adopted as son by his father-in-law, surnamed Li, and was registered in Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: At first he was adopted as son by his father-in-law, surnamed Li, and was registered in Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十九年成進士，歸本宗，授直隸南樂知縣。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year of the Qianlong reign he passed the jinshi examination, returned to his original clan, and was appointed magistrate of Nanle in Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year of the Qianlong reign (1754) he passed the jinshi examination, returned to his original clan, and was appointed magistrate of Nanle in Zhili.

sentences.zh: 慎於折獄，於片紙召兩造，立剖曲直，當笞者薄責之，民輒感悔自新。

translations.literal: He was careful in deciding cases. With a single slip of paper he would summon both parties, immediately discern right from wrong, and lightly punish those due for bamboo strokes; the people would invariably be moved to repentance and reform.
translations.idiomatic: He was careful in deciding cases. With a single slip of paper he would summon both parties, immediately discern right from wrong, and lightly punish those due for the bamboo; the people would invariably be moved to repent and reform.

sentences.zh: 擇清白謹願者充社長、裡正，令密陳利弊，以次行之。

translations.literal: He selected men of clean character and cautious disposition to serve as village heads and ward chiefs, had them report on benefits and harms in secret, and implemented reforms in turn.
translations.idiomatic: He selected men of clean character and cautious disposition to serve as village heads and ward chiefs, had them report benefits and harms in secret, and carried out reforms one by one.

sentences.zh: 縣當豬龍河之衝，察河源委，於開州、清豐之間審地形高下，因勢利導，水不為患。

translations.literal: The county lay on the Zhulong River's course. He investigated the river's source and flow, studied the terrain's elevation between Kaizhou and Qingfeng, and guided the water according to its natural tendencies so that it no longer caused disaster.
translations.idiomatic: The county lay on the Zhulong River's course. He traced the river's source and flow, studied the terrain between Kaizhou and Qingfeng, and guided the water according to its natural tendencies so that it no longer caused disaster.

sentences.zh: 地多茅沙鹽咸，教以土化之法，廣植雜樹。

translations.literal: The land was mostly sandy, saline, and salty; he taught methods of soil improvement and widely planted assorted trees.
translations.idiomatic: The land was mostly sandy, saline, and salty; he taught methods of soil improvement and widely planted assorted trees.

sentences.zh: 鄉民以麥稭編笠為生，敦和勸種桑。

translations.literal: The villagers made their living weaving hats from wheat straw; Dunhe encouraged them to plant mulberry trees.
translations.idiomatic: The villagers made their living weaving hats from wheat straw; Dunhe encouraged them to plant mulberry trees.

sentences.zh: 調大名，漳水患劇，旁有渠河，敦和謀開渠以殺其勢。

translations.literal: Transferred to Daming, where the Zhang River's floods were severe; there was a canal nearby, and Dunhe planned to open a channel to reduce its force.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred to Daming, where the Zhang River's floods were severe, he found a canal nearby and planned to open a channel to reduce the river's force.

sentences.zh: 適內遷大理寺評事，不及上請。

translations.literal: He was soon transferred inward to serve as reviewing officer of the Court of Judicial Review and did not have time to submit the memorial.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon transferred inward to serve as reviewing officer of the Court of Judicial Review and did not have time to submit the memorial.

sentences.zh: 乃手書揭城門，勸民刻期集河干，親為指示，民具畚鍤來者以萬計。

translations.literal: So he wrote a notice by hand and posted it at the city gate, urging the people to gather at the riverbank on a set date; he personally directed the work, and residents bringing spades and baskets numbered in the tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: So he wrote a notice by hand and posted it at the city gate, urging the people to gather at the riverbank on a set date; he personally directed the work, and residents bringing spades and baskets numbered in the tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 經旬而渠成，後利賴之。

translations.literal: Within ten days the channel was completed, and afterwards the people benefited from it for generations.
translations.idiomatic: Within ten days the channel was completed, and afterwards the people benefited from it for generations.

sentences.zh: 尋復出為湖北德安府同知，署宜昌知府，緣事降秩。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was again sent out as sub-prefect of De'an Prefecture in Hubei and served as acting prefect of Yichang; because of some matter he was demoted in rank.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was again sent out as sub-prefect of De'an Prefecture in Hubei and served as acting prefect of Yichang; because of some matter he was demoted in rank.

sentences.zh: 卒，祀直隸名宦祠。

translations.literal: He died and was enshrined in the shrine of renowned officials of Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: He died and was enshrined in the shrine of renowned officials of Zhili.

sentences.zh: 子棻，以一甲一名進士官至兵部尚書。

translations.literal: His son Fen passed the jinshi examination as top of the first class and rose to minister of war.
translations.idiomatic: His son Fen passed the jinshi examination as top of the first class and rose to minister of war.

sentences.zh: 休度，字介斐，浙江秀水人。

translations.literal: Xiudu, courtesy name Jiefei, was a native of Xiushui in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Xiudu, courtesy name Jiefei, was from Xiushui in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十八年舉人，官嵊縣訓導，以薦授山西廣靈知縣。

translations.literal: A provincial graduate in the eighteenth year of the Qianlong reign, he served as instructor at Sheng County; through recommendation he was appointed magistrate of Guangling in Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: A provincial graduate in the eighteenth year of the Qianlong reign (1753), he served as instructor at Sheng County; through recommendation he was appointed magistrate of Guangling in Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 值大荒疫，流亡過半，休度安撫招徠。

translations.literal: During a great famine and epidemic, more than half the population fled; Xiudu comforted them and summoned the displaced to return.
translations.idiomatic: During a great famine and epidemic, more than half the population fled; Xiudu comforted them and summoned the displaced to return.

sentences.zh: 糧籍舊未清，履勘勸耕，一年而荒者墾，三年而無曠土。

translations.literal: Old grain registers had never been cleared up; he went out to inspect the land and urged farming. Within a year wasteland was reclaimed; within three years there was no untilled soil.
translations.idiomatic: Old grain registers had never been cleared up; he went out to inspect the land and urged farming. Within a year wasteland was reclaimed; within three years there was no untilled soil.

sentences.zh: 糧清賦辦，獲優敘。

translations.literal: Once the grain registers were cleared and tax duties fulfilled, he received a commendation for outstanding service.
translations.idiomatic: Once the grain registers were cleared and tax duties fulfilled, he received a commendation for outstanding service.

sentences.zh: 尤善決獄，劉杷子妻張，以夫出，飢欲死，易姓改嫁郭添保。

translations.literal: He was especially skilled at deciding cases. Liu Pazi's wife Zhang, because her husband was away and she was starving to death, changed her surname and remarried Guo Tianbao.
translations.idiomatic: He was especially skilled at deciding cases. Liu Pazi's wife Zhang, because her husband was away and she was starving to death, changed her surname and remarried Guo Tianbao.

sentences.zh: 疑郭為略賣，詰朝手刃所生子女二而自剄。

translations.literal: Suspecting that Guo had abducted and sold her, the next morning she killed with her own hand the two children she had borne and slit her own throat.
translations.idiomatic: Suspecting that Guo had abducted and sold her, the next morning she killed with her own hand the two children she had borne and slit her own throat.

sentences.zh: 休度詣驗，婦猶未絕，目郭作聲曰：「販，販！

translations.literal: Xiudu went to examine the scene. The woman was not yet dead; she fixed her eyes on Guo and cried out, "Trafficker! Trafficker!
translations.idiomatic: Xiudu went to examine the scene. The woman was not yet dead; she fixed her eyes on Guo and cried out, "Trafficker! Trafficker!

sentences.zh: 」察其無他情，讞定，杷子乃歸。

translations.literal: Having ascertained that there was no other motive involved, he settled the verdict, and Pazi then returned home.
translations.idiomatic: Having ascertained that there was no other motive involved, he settled the verdict, and Pazi then returned home.

sentences.zh: 眾曰：「汝欲知婦所由死，問硃爺。

translations.literal: The crowd said, "If you want to know why your wife died, ask Master Zhu.
translations.idiomatic: The crowd said, "If you want to know why your wife died, ask Master Zhu.

sentences.zh: 」休度語之狀，並及其家某事某事。

translations.literal: Xiudu told him what had happened, and also mentioned certain matters concerning his household.
translations.idiomatic: Xiudu told him what had happened, and also mentioned certain matters concerning his household.

sentences.zh: 杷子泣曰：「我歸愆期至此，勿怨他人矣。

translations.literal: Pazi wept and said, "My delayed return brought this about—let no one else be blamed.
translations.idiomatic: Pazi wept and said, "My delayed return brought this about—let no one else be blamed.

sentences.zh: 」稽首去。

translations.literal: He bowed his head and departed.
translations.idiomatic: He bowed his head and departed.

sentences.zh: 薛石頭偕妹觀劇，其友目送之。

translations.literal: Xue Shitou went with his sister to watch an opera; a friend watched them leave with his eyes.
translations.idiomatic: Xue Shitou went with his sister to watch an opera; a friend watched them leave with his eyes.

sentences.zh: 薛怒，刃傷其左乳，死。

translations.literal: Xue flew into a rage and stabbed him in the left breast; the man died.
translations.idiomatic: Xue flew into a rage and stabbed him in the left breast; the man died.

sentences.zh: 自承曰：「早欲殺之，死​​無恨。

translations.literal: He confessed of his own accord: "I had long wanted to kill him—death brings no regret.
translations.idiomatic: He confessed of his own accord: "I had long wanted to kill him—death brings no regret.

sentences.zh: 」越日，复詰之曰：「一刃何即死也？

translations.literal: The next day Xiudu questioned him again: "How could one stroke of the blade kill him immediately?
translations.idiomatic: The next day Xiudu questioned him again: "How could one stroke of the blade kill him immediately?

sentences.zh: 」薛曰：「刃時不料即死。

translations.literal: Xue said, "When I stabbed him, I did not expect he would die at once.
translations.idiomatic: Xue said, "When I stabbed him, I did not expect he would die at once.

sentences.zh: 」曰：「何不再刃？

translations.literal: Xiudu said, "Why did you not strike again?
translations.idiomatic: Xiudu said, "Why did you not strike again?

sentences.zh: 」薛曰：「見其血出不止，心惕息，何忍再刃？

translations.literal: Xue said, "Seeing the blood flow without stopping, my heart faltered—I could not bear to strike again.
translations.idiomatic: Xue said, "Seeing the blood flow without stopping, my heart faltered—I could not bear to strike again.

sentences.zh: 」遂以誤殺論，減戍。

translations.literal: Accordingly he was sentenced under the category of unintentional killing, with commuted penal servitude.
translations.idiomatic: Accordingly he was sentenced under the category of unintentional killing, with commuted penal servitude.

sentences.zh: 休度嘗曰：「南方獄多法輕情重，北方獄多法重情輕，稍忽之，失其情矣。

translations.literal: Xiudu once said: "In the south, cases often involve light penalties for heavy offenses of passion; in the north, cases often involve heavy penalties for light offenses of passion. Neglect this even slightly and the true circumstances are lost.
translations.idiomatic: Xiudu once said: "In the south, cases often involve light penalties for heavy offenses of passion; in the north, cases often involve heavy penalties for light offenses of passion. Neglect this even slightly and the true circumstances are lost.

sentences.zh: 」待人以誠，人亦不忍欺。

translations.literal: He treated people with sincerity, and they could not bring themselves to deceive him.
translations.idiomatic: He treated people with sincerity, and they could not bring themselves to deceive him.

sentences.zh: 周知民情，訴曲直者，數語處分，民皆悅服。

translations.literal: Thoroughly acquainted with the people's circumstances, when litigants came seeking judgment he disposed of matters in a few words, and the people all submitted gladly.
translations.idiomatic: Thoroughly acquainted with the people's circumstances, when litigants came seeking judgment he disposed of matters in a few words, and the people all submitted gladly.

sentences.zh: 數年囹圄一空，舉卓異。

translations.literal: Within a few years the prisons stood empty, and he was recommended as exceptionally meritorious.
translations.idiomatic: Within a few years the prisons stood empty, and he was recommended as exceptionally meritorious.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年，引疾歸，縣人懇留不得，乞其「壺山垂釣」小像勒諸石。

translations.literal: In the first year of the Jiaqing reign, citing illness he returned home. The county people pleaded in vain for him to stay and asked that his small portrait "Fishing on Mount Hu" be carved in stone.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Jiaqing reign (1796), citing illness he returned home. The county people pleaded in vain for him to stay and asked that his small portrait "Fishing on Mount Hu" be carved in stone.

sentences.zh: 歿後，祀名宦。

translations.literal: After his death he was enshrined among renowned officials.
translations.idiomatic: After his death he was enshrined among renowned officials.

sentences.zh: 休度博聞通識，尤深於詩，以其鄉硃彝尊、錢載為法。

translations.literal: Xiudu was broadly learned and deeply insightful, especially accomplished in poetry, taking as his models the natives of his region Zhu Yizun and Qian Zai.
translations.idiomatic: Xiudu was broadly learned and deeply insightful, especially accomplished in poetry, taking as his models the natives of his region Zhu Yizun and Qian Zai.

sentences.zh: 任校官時，採訪遺書，得四千五百餘種​​，撰總目上諸四庫。

translations.literal: While serving as a school official, he collected and investigated lost books, obtaining more than 4,500 titles, compiled a general catalog, and submitted it to the Siku Library.
translations.idiomatic: While serving as a school official, he collected and investigated lost books, obtaining more than 4,500 titles, compiled a general catalog, and submitted it to the Siku Library.

sentences.zh: 大學士王杰為學政，任其一人以集事，時盛稱焉。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Wang Jie, serving as provincial education commissioner, entrusted the whole undertaking to him alone, and at the time this was widely praised.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Wang Jie, serving as provincial education commissioner, entrusted the whole undertaking to him alone, and at the time this was widely praised.

sentences.zh: =劉大紳=劉大紳，字寄庵，雲南寧州人。

translations.literal: Liu Dashen. Liu Dashen, courtesy name Ji'an, was a native of Ningzhou in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Dashen. Liu Dashen, courtesy name Ji'an, was from Ningzhou in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三十七年進士，四十八年，授山東新城知縣。

translations.literal: A jinshi in the thirty-seventh year of the Qianlong reign, in the forty-eighth year he was appointed magistrate of Xincheng in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: A jinshi in the thirty-seventh year of the Qianlong reign (1772), in the forty-eighth year (1783) he was appointed magistrate of Xincheng in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 連三歲旱，大紳力賑之。

translations.literal: For three consecutive years there was drought; Dashen exerted himself to provide relief.
translations.idiomatic: For three consecutive years there was drought; Dashen exerted himself to provide relief.

sentences.zh: 調曹縣，代者至，民數千遮道乞留，大吏為留大紳三月。

translations.literal: Transferred to Cao County; when his replacement arrived, several thousand people blocked the road begging him to stay, and the provincial authorities kept Dashen for three months.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred to Cao County; when his replacement arrived, several thousand people blocked the road begging him to stay, and the provincial authorities kept Dashen for three months.

sentences.zh: 及至曹縣，旱災更重於新城。

translations.literal: When he reached Cao County, the drought disaster was more severe than at Xincheng.
translations.idiomatic: When he reached Cao County, the drought disaster was more severe than at Xincheng.

sentences.zh: 大紳方務與休息，河督檄修趙王河決堤，集夫萬餘人，以工代賑，兩月竣事，無疾病逃亡者。

translations.literal: Dashen was just beginning to give the people rest when the river commissioner ordered repairs to a breach in the Zhao Wang River dike. He assembled more than ten thousand laborers and used work-relief in place of famine relief; within two months the project was finished, with no sickness or flight among the workers.
translations.idiomatic: Dashen was just beginning to give the people rest when the river commissioner ordered repairs to a breach in the Zhao Wang River dike. He assembled more than ten thousand laborers and used work-relief in place of famine relief; within two months the project was finished, with no sickness or flight among the workers.

sentences.zh: 既又檄辦河工稭料三百萬，大紳以時方收斂，請緩之。

translations.literal: Soon afterward another order came to procure three million bundles of straw for river works. Dashen, noting that the harvest season was just beginning, requested a postponement.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward another order came to procure three million bundles of straw for river works. Dashen, noting that the harvest season was just beginning, requested a postponement.

sentences.zh: 大吏督責益急，將按以罪，請限十日，民聞，爭先輸納，未即期而數足。

translations.literal: The provincial authorities pressed him all the more urgently and were about to charge him with an offense. He asked for a limit of ten days; when the people heard of this, they vied to deliver the material, and before the deadline the quota was met.
translations.idiomatic: The provincial authorities pressed him all the more urgently and were about to charge him with an offense. He asked for a limit of ten days; when the people heard of this, they vied to deliver the material, and before the deadline the quota was met.

sentences.zh: 一日巡行鄉間，有於馬後議穀賤銀貴開徵期迫者，大紳顧語之曰：「俟穀得價再輸未遲也。

translations.literal: One day while making the rounds in the countryside, he overheard people behind his horse discussing how grain was cheap, silver dear, and the tax collection deadline pressing. Dashen turned and said to them, "Wait until grain fetches a good price before paying—it will not be too late.
translations.idiomatic: One day while making the rounds in the countryside, he overheard people behind his horse discussing how grain was cheap, silver dear, and the tax collection deadline pressing. Dashen turned and said to them, "Wait until grain fetches a good price before paying—it will not be too late.

sentences.zh: 」語聞於大吏，怒其擅自緩徵，遣能吏代之。

translations.literal: When word of this reached the provincial authorities, they were enraged that he had on his own authority postponed collection and sent a capable official to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: When word of this reached the provincial authorities, they were enraged that he had on his own authority postponed collection and sent a capable official to replace him.

sentences.zh: 民慮失大紳，爭輸賦，代者至，已畢完。

translations.literal: The people, fearing they would lose Dashen, vied to pay their taxes; by the time his replacement arrived, collection was already complete.
translations.idiomatic: The people, fearing they would lose Dashen, vied to pay their taxes; by the time his replacement arrived, collection was already complete.

sentences.zh: 大吏因責徵累年逋，久倘不足，終以代者受事。

translations.literal: The provincial authorities therefore charged him with years of accumulated arrears in tax collection; when the delay stretched long and the amount still fell short, in the end the replacement official bore the consequences.
translations.idiomatic: The provincial authorities therefore charged him with years of accumulated arrears in tax collection; when the delay stretched long and the amount still fell short, in the end the replacement official bore the consequences.

sentences.zh: 民益恐，晝夜輸將，不數日得三萬餘兩。

translations.literal: The people grew still more alarmed and delivered payments day and night; within a few days more than thirty thousand taels were collected.
translations.idiomatic: The people grew still more alarmed and delivered payments day and night; within a few days more than thirty thousand taels were collected.

sentences.zh: 初，大紳以忤上官意，自劾求去，民環署泣留，相率走訴大吏。

translations.literal: Earlier, because Dashen had offended his superiors, he submitted a self-accusation asking to leave office. The people surrounded the yamen weeping and begging him to stay, and went in groups to petition the provincial authorities.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, because Dashen had offended his superiors, he submitted a self-accusation asking to leave office. The people surrounded the yamen weeping and begging him to stay, and went in groups to petition the provincial authorities.

sentences.zh: 適大吏有事泰山，路見而諭止之，不得去。

translations.literal: It happened that the provincial authorities were occupied with affairs at Mount Tai; they saw the petitioners on the road and ordered them to stop, and Dashen could not leave.
translations.idiomatic: It happened that the provincial authorities were occupied with affairs at Mount Tai; they saw the petitioners on the road and ordered them to stop, and Dashen could not leave.

sentences.zh: 至是密自申請，民知之，已無及，乃得引疾歸。

translations.literal: At this point he secretly submitted his own request; when the people learned of it, it was already too late, and he was finally able to return home citing illness.
translations.idiomatic: At this point he secretly submitted his own request; when the people learned of it, it was already too late, and he was finally able to return home citing illness.

sentences.zh: 五十八年，病起，仍發山東，補文登。

translations.literal: In the fifty-eighth year, recovered from illness, he was again sent to Shandong and appointed to Wendeng.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-eighth year (1793), recovered from illness, he was again sent to Shandong and appointed to Wendeng.

sentences.zh: 值新城修城，大吏徇士民請，檄大紳督工，逾年始竣，尋以曹縣舊獄被議，罷職遣戍。

translations.literal: When Xincheng was repairing its walls, the provincial authorities yielded to the gentry and common people's request and ordered Dashen to supervise the work; after more than a year it was completed. Soon afterward, because of an old case at Cao County, he was censured, dismissed from office, and sent into exile.
translations.idiomatic: When Xincheng was repairing its walls, the provincial authorities yielded to the gentry and common people's request and ordered Dashen to supervise the work; after more than a year it was completed. Soon afterward, because of an old case at Cao County, he was censured, dismissed from office, and sent into exile.

sentences.zh: 新城、曹縣民為捐金請贖，得免歸。

translations.literal: The people of Xincheng and Cao County contributed money to petition for his ransom, and he was released to return home.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Xincheng and Cao County contributed money to petition for his ransom, and he was released to return home.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶五年，有密薦者，詔以大紳操守廉潔、兼有才能，辦理城工、渡船二事，民情愛戴，引見，復發山東，攝福山，補朝城。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of the Jiaqing reign, someone submitted a confidential recommendation. An edict noted that Dashen's conduct was incorruptible and that he combined talent with ability; in his handling of the wall construction and ferryboat projects the people's sentiments were devoted to him. Summoned for audience, he was again sent to Shandong, served as acting magistrate of Fushan, and was appointed to Chaocheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of the Jiaqing reign (1800), someone submitted a confidential recommendation. An edict noted that Dashen's conduct was incorruptible and that he combined talent with ability; in his handling of the wall construction and ferryboat projects the people's sentiments were devoted to him. Summoned for audience, he was again sent to Shandong, served as acting magistrate of Fushan, and was appointed to Chaocheng.

sentences.zh: 大水，大紳以災報，大吏駁減其分數，民感大紳，雖未獲減徵，亦無怨謗者。

translations.literal: During a great flood, Dashen reported the disaster; the provincial authorities rejected his assessment and reduced the relief quota. The people were grateful to Dashen; even though they did not receive reduced taxes, none spoke in resentment.
translations.idiomatic: During a great flood, Dashen reported the disaster; the provincial authorities rejected his assessment and reduced the relief quota. The people were grateful to Dashen; even though they did not receive reduced taxes, none spoke in resentment.

sentences.zh: 大紳又力以病求去，移攝青州府同知，尋擢武定府同知。

translations.literal: Dashen again strongly petitioned to leave on grounds of illness, was transferred to serve as sub-prefect of Qingzhou Prefecture, and soon was promoted to sub-prefect of Wuding Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Dashen again strongly petitioned to leave on grounds of illness, was transferred to serve as sub-prefect of Qingzhou Prefecture, and soon was promoted to sub-prefect of Wuding Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 捕蝗查賑，並著勞勚。

translations.literal: In locust-catching and disaster relief inspection he likewise distinguished himself through arduous service.
translations.idiomatic: In locust-catching and disaster relief inspection he likewise distinguished himself through arduous service.

sentences.zh: 以母老終養歸，遂不出。

translations.literal: Because his mother was aged, he returned home to care for her until her death and did not take office again.
translations.idiomatic: Because his mother was aged, he returned home to care for her until her death and did not take office again.

sentences.zh: 卒，祀名宦祠。

translations.literal: He died and was enshrined in the shrine of renowned officials.
translations.idiomatic: He died and was enshrined in the shrine of renowned officials.

sentences.zh: 大紳素講學能文章，在官公暇，輒詣書院課士。

translations.literal: Dashen had long been devoted to learning and was skilled at literary composition; during leisure hours in office he would go to the academy to examine the students.
translations.idiomatic: Dashen had long been devoted to learning and was skilled at literary composition; during leisure hours in office he would go to the academy to examine the students.

sentences.zh: 嘗訓諸生曰：「硃子小學，為作聖階梯，入德塗軌。

translations.literal: He once instructed the students: "Master Zhu's Elementary Learning is the ladder to sagehood and the path into virtue.
translations.idiomatic: He once instructed the students: "Master Zhu's Elementary Learning is the ladder to sagehood and the path into virtue.

sentences.zh: 必讀此書，身體力行，庶幾明體達用，有益於天下國家之大。

translations.literal: You must read this book and practice it in body and deed; only then may you clarify principle and apply it usefully, to the great benefit of all under Heaven and the state.
translations.idiomatic: You must read this book and practice it in body and deed; only then may you clarify principle and apply it usefully, to the great benefit of all under Heaven and the state.

sentences.zh: 」於是士知實學，風氣一變。

translations.literal: Thereupon the scholars understood practical learning, and local custom was transformed.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the scholars understood practical learning, and local custom was transformed.

sentences.zh: =吳煥彩=吳煥彩，字蘊之，福建安定人。

translations.literal: Wu Huancai. Wu Huancai, courtesy name Yunzhi, was a native of Anding in Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Huancai. Wu Huancai, courtesy name Yunzhi, was from Anding in Fujian.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十五年進士，授山東範縣知縣。

translations.literal: A jinshi in the twenty-fifth year of the Qianlong reign, he was appointed magistrate of Fan County in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: A jinshi in the twenty-fifth year of the Qianlong reign (1760), he was appointed magistrate of Fan County in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 民苦充牌頭。

translations.literal: The people suffered under compulsory service as pai headmen.
translations.idiomatic: The people suffered under compulsory service as pai headmen.

sentences.zh: 吏列多名進，以次需索，煥彩革其弊。

translations.literal: Officials would register many names and demand fees in sequence; Huancai abolished this abuse.
translations.idiomatic: Officials would register many names and demand fees in sequence; Huancai abolished this abuse.

sentences.zh: 清河水溢為災，其岸左高右卑，因開五頃窪，以瀉其東南；

translations.literal: The Qing River overflowed and caused disaster; its banks were higher on the left and lower on the right, so he opened the Wuqing depression to drain the southeast;
translations.idiomatic: The Qing River overflowed and caused disaster; its banks were higher on the left and lower on the right, so he opened the Wuqing depression to drain the southeast;

sentences.zh: 築福金堤，以防其西北；

translations.literal: and built the Fujin Dike to block the northwest;
translations.idiomatic: and built the Fujin Dike to block the northwest;

sentences.zh: 歲得麥田四萬畝。

translations.literal: gaining forty thousand mu of wheat fields each year.
translations.idiomatic: gaining forty thousand mu of wheat fields each year.

sentences.zh: 啇地民苦納租，欲請免而格於例，代輸租之半，教之種番薯，民困乃紓。

translations.literal: The people of Shangdi suffered under rent payments; they wished to petition for exemption but were blocked by regulation. Huancai paid half their rent on their behalf and taught them to plant sweet potatoes, and the people's hardship was eased.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Shangdi suffered under rent payments; they wished to petition for exemption but were blocked by regulation. Huancai paid half their rent on their behalf and taught them to plant sweet potatoes, and the people's hardship was eased.

sentences.zh: 三十九年，壽張逆匪王倫作亂，距範縣四十里，煥彩修城籌守禦，力清保甲，凡村落大小，人民賢愚可指數。

translations.literal: In the thirty-ninth year, the rebel Wang Lun of Shouzhang rose in revolt forty li from Fan County. Huancai repaired the walls and prepared defenses, vigorously reorganized the baojia system, and could account for every village, large or small, and every person, worthy or foolish.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-ninth year (1774), the rebel Wang Lun of Shouzhang rose in revolt forty li from Fan County. Huancai repaired the walls and prepared defenses, vigorously reorganized the baojia system, and could account for every village, large or small, and every person, worthy or foolish.

sentences.zh: 有孟興璧者，與黃昌吉等有隙，上變列三十餘人，朝命侍郎高樸與巡撫往察治。

translations.literal: A man named Meng Xingbi, who had a grudge against Huang Changji and others, submitted a secret report listing more than thirty people. The court ordered Vice Minister Gao Pu and the provincial governor to go investigate.
translations.idiomatic: A man named Meng Xingbi, who had a grudge against Huang Changji and others, submitted a secret report listing more than thirty people. The court ordered Vice Minister Gao Pu and the provincial governor to go investigate.

sentences.zh: 使者出牒示，煥彩曰：「某已死，某為某之父，某之子皆良民，呼之即至。

translations.literal: The envoy produced the warrant for inspection. Huancai said, "So-and-so is already dead; so-and-so is so-and-so's father; so-and-so's son—all are law-abiding people. Summon them and they will come at once.
translations.idiomatic: The envoy produced the warrant for inspection. Huancai said, "So-and-so is already dead; so-and-so is so-and-so's father; so-and-so's son—all are law-abiding people. Summon them and they will come at once.

sentences.zh: 」使者欲以兵往，煥彩曰：「兵至，愚民非死即走，無可訊，咎將誰執？

translations.literal: The envoy wished to send troops. Huancai said, "When troops arrive, the common people will either die or flee—there will be no one to question. Who will bear the blame?
translations.idiomatic: The envoy wished to send troops. Huancai said, "When troops arrive, the common people will either die or flee—there will be no one to question. Who will bear the blame?

sentences.zh: 」煥彩夜抵村中呼告之，皆呼冤。

translations.literal: That night Huancai went to the villages and summoned the people to hear their grievances; all cried out their innocence.
translations.idiomatic: That night Huancai went to the villages and summoned the people to hear their grievances; all cried out their innocence.

sentences.zh: 煥彩曰：「惟無其事，必出就訊，亟從我去。

translations.literal: Huancai said, "Since there is no truth to the charges, you must come out to be questioned—come with me at once.
translations.idiomatic: Huancai said, "Since there is no truth to the charges, you must come out to be questioned—come with me at once.

sentences.zh: 不然，禍立至。

translations.literal: Otherwise disaster will come immediately.
translations.idiomatic: Otherwise disaster will come immediately.

sentences.zh: 」民皆裹糧從。

translations.literal: The people all packed provisions and followed him.
translations.idiomatic: The people all packed provisions and followed him.

sentences.zh: 使者按籍，少二人，煥彩曰：「一已死，一外出，已命其兄招之。

translations.literal: The envoy checked against the register and found two people missing. Huancai said, "One is already dead; one is away from home—I have ordered his elder brother to summon him.
translations.idiomatic: The envoy checked against the register and found two people missing. Huancai said, "One is already dead; one is away from home—I have ordered his elder brother to summon him.

sentences.zh: 」言未畢，有跪門外者，則已來矣。

translations.literal: Before he had finished speaking, someone was kneeling outside the gate—it was the man, already arrived.
translations.idiomatic: Before he had finished speaking, someone was kneeling outside the gate—it was the man, already arrived.

sentences.zh: 訊之皆誣，遂坐告變者。

translations.literal: On examination all charges proved false, and the accuser was punished.
translations.idiomatic: On examination all charges proved false, and the accuser was punished.

sentences.zh: 巡撫曰：「知縣者，知一縣事，君可謂之知縣矣。

translations.literal: The governor said, "A magistrate is one who knows the affairs of a whole county—you may truly be called a magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: The governor said, "A magistrate is one who knows the affairs of a whole county—you may truly be called a magistrate.

sentences.zh: 知縣者，民之父母，君可謂之民之父母矣。

translations.literal: A magistrate is the parent of the people—you may truly be called the parent of the people.
translations.idiomatic: A magistrate is the parent of the people—you may truly be called the parent of the people.

sentences.zh: 」以卓異薦，擢湖北鶴峰知州。

translations.literal: Recommended as exceptionally meritorious, he was promoted to prefect of Hefeng in Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: Recommended as exceptionally meritorious, he was promoted to prefect of Hefeng in Hubei.

sentences.zh: 地本苗疆，改流未久，姦宄雜居。

translations.literal: The territory had originally been Miao frontier country; direct administration had only recently been imposed, and evildoers of all sorts lived side by side.
translations.idiomatic: The territory had originally been Miao frontier country; direct administration had only recently been imposed, and evildoers of all sorts lived side by side.

sentences.zh: 煥彩勤於聽訟，積弊一清。

translations.literal: Huancai was diligent in hearing cases, and longstanding abuses were entirely cleared away.
translations.idiomatic: Huancai was diligent in hearing cases, and longstanding abuses were entirely cleared away.

sentences.zh: 土司族裔，每借祖墳詐人財，懲治之，澆風自息。

translations.literal: Descendants of native chieftains often used ancestral graves to defraud people of their property; he punished this, and the corrupt custom ceased of itself.
translations.idiomatic: Relatives of the local tusi chieftains had a habit of using claims to ancestral graves to swindle people out of their money; once he prosecuted the practice, that venal custom died away.

sentences.zh: 民樸陋不知書，設義塾，資以膏火，至五十三年，始有舉於鄉者。

translations.literal: The people were simple and uncouth and did not know books; he established charity schools and supplied them with lamp-oil funds, and by the fifty-third year there were finally those who passed the provincial examination.
translations.idiomatic: The people were rough and illiterate; he set up charity schools and subsidized their study expenses, and by the fifty-third year someone from the district had finally passed the provincial examinations for the first time.

sentences.zh: 後以病歸，鶴峰請祀名宦，範縣亦為建生祠。

translations.literal: Later he returned home due to illness; Hefeng requested that he be enshrined among distinguished officials, and Fan County also built him a living shrine.
translations.idiomatic: He later resigned and went home on account of illness. Hefeng petitioned to have him honored in the shrine of distinguished officials, and Fan County erected a living shrine in his memory as well.

sentences.zh: 年逾八十，卒。

translations.literal: He passed the age of eighty and died.
translations.idiomatic: He was over eighty when he died.

sentences.zh: =紀大奎=紀大奎，字慎齋，江西臨川人。

translations.literal: Ji Dakui. Ji Dakui, courtesy name Shenzhai, was a native of Linchuan in Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Ji Dakui. Ji Dakui, styled Shenzhai, was from Linchuan in Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四十四年舉人，充四庫館謄錄。

translations.literal: A juren in the forty-fourth year of Qianlong, he served as a copyist at the Siku Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the provincial examinations in the forty-fourth year of the Qianlong reign (1779) and worked as a copyist at the Siku Quanshu project.

sentences.zh: 五十年，議敘知縣，發山東，署商河。

translations.literal: In the fiftieth year, he was considered for appointment as magistrate, was sent to Shandong, and served as acting magistrate of Shanghe.
translations.idiomatic: In the fiftieth year of Qianlong (1785), his record qualified him for a magistracy; he was posted to Shandong and served as acting magistrate of Shanghe.

sentences.zh: 會李文功等倡邪教，誘民為亂，訛言四起。

translations.literal: At that time Li Wengong and others promoted a heterodox cult, leading the people into rebellion, and false rumors arose on every side.
translations.idiomatic: About then Li Wengong and his followers were preaching a heretical sect and inciting the people to revolt, and wild rumors spread everywhere.

sentences.zh: 大奎集縣民，諭以禍福，皆驚悟。

translations.literal: Dakui gathered the county's people and instructed them on fortune and disaster; all were startled into understanding.
translations.idiomatic: Dakui summoned the people of the county and explained to them the consequences of their choices; they were shaken awake and saw reason.

sentences.zh: 鄰郡惑者聞之，亦相率解散。

translations.literal: Those who had been misled in neighboring prefectures heard of this and likewise dispersed one after another.
translations.idiomatic: Misguided people in neighboring districts heard what had happened and likewise abandoned the movement in droves.

sentences.zh: 補丘縣，歷署昌樂、棲霞、福山、博平，民皆敬而親之。

translations.literal: He was appointed to Qiu County, and successively served as acting magistrate of Changle, Qixia, Fushan, and Boping; the people all revered and felt close to him.
translations.idiomatic: He was assigned to Qiu County and later served in turn as acting magistrate of Changle, Qixia, Fushan, and Boping, winning the respect and affection of the people wherever he went.

sentences.zh: 父憂歸。

translations.literal: He returned home upon his father's death.
translations.idiomatic: He went home to observe mourning for his father.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶中復出，授四川什邡縣。

translations.literal: In the Jiaqing era he returned to office and was appointed to Shifang County in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: During the Jiaqing reign he returned to government service and was appointed magistrate of Shifang in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 或謂：「什邡俗強梗，宜示以威。

translations.literal: Someone said: "The customs of Shifang are tough and obstinate; it would be best to show them authority."
translations.idiomatic: Some advised him: "The people of Shifang are notoriously hard and unyielding; you ought to rule them with a firm hand."

sentences.zh: 」答曰：「無德可懷，徒以威示，何益？

translations.literal: He replied: "With no virtue to win their hearts, what good is it merely to display authority?"
translations.idiomatic: He answered: "If you have no virtue to inspire loyalty, what good does it do to rely on intimidation alone?"

sentences.zh: 」奸民吳忠友據山中聚眾積粟，講清涼教。

translations.literal: The wicked commoner Wu Zhongyou occupied the mountains, gathered a crowd, hoarded grain, and preached the Qingliang sect.
translations.idiomatic: A local ruffian named Wu Zhongyou had taken to the hills, where he gathered followers, stockpiled grain, and spread the Qingliang sect.

sentences.zh: 大奎躬率健役，夜半搗其巢，獲忠友，餘眾驚散。

translations.literal: Dakui personally led vigorous yamen runners and in the middle of the night raided their nest, captured Zhongyou, and the rest scattered in alarm.
translations.idiomatic: Dakui personally led a band of sturdy runners on a midnight raid of their hideout, captured Zhongyou, and the remaining followers fled in panic.

sentences.zh: 下令受邪書者三日繳，予自新，民遂安。

translations.literal: He ordered that those who possessed heterodox books must surrender them within three days on promise of renewal, and the people were then at peace.
translations.idiomatic: He decreed a three-day amnesty for anyone holding heretical texts to turn them in and start afresh, and the people settled down.

sentences.zh: 擢合州知州，道光二年，引疾歸。

translations.literal: He was promoted to prefect of Hezhou; in the second year of Daoguang he cited illness and returned home.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to prefect of Hezhou, and in the second year of the Daoguang reign (1822) he resigned on grounds of ill health.

sentences.zh: 年八十，卒，祀合州名宦。

translations.literal: At the age of eighty he died and was enshrined among Hezhou's distinguished officials.
translations.idiomatic: He died at eighty and was honored in the shrine of distinguished officials at Hezhou.

sentences.zh: =邵希曾=邵希曾，字魯齋，浙江錢塘人。

translations.literal: Shao Xiceng. Shao Xiceng, courtesy name Luzhai, was a native of Qiantang in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Shao Xiceng. Shao Xiceng, styled Luzhai, was from Qiantang in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 乾隆五十四年舉人，嘉慶中，官河南知縣。

translations.literal: A juren in the fifty-fourth year of Qianlong, in the Jiaqing era he served as magistrate in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: He received his juren degree in the fifty-fourth year of the Qianlong reign (1789) and during the Jiaqing era served as a magistrate in Henan.

sentences.zh: 歷權通許、盧氏、鄢陵、西華、沈丘、太康、扶構、淮寧、新鄉，皆有聲。

translations.literal: He successively served in acting capacity at Tongxu, Lushi, Yanling, Xihua, Shenqiu, Taikang, Fugou, Huaining, and Xinxiang, and at each gained reputation.
translations.idiomatic: He served in turn as acting magistrate of Tongxu, Lushi, Yanling, Xihua, Shenqiu, Taikang, Fugou, Huaining, and Xinxiang, earning a fine reputation at every post.

sentences.zh: 滑縣教匪之役，司糧台。

translations.literal: During the campaign against the sect rebels at Huaxian, he managed the grain-supply station.
translations.idiomatic: During the campaign against the sect rebels at Huaxian, he ran the grain-supply commissary.

sentences.zh: 及匪平，訊鞫俘虜，治餘匪，凡良民被脅者皆得釋，保全甚眾。

translations.literal: When the rebels were pacified, he interrogated and tried prisoners, dealt with remaining rebels, and all good commoners who had been coerced were released; very many were preserved.
translations.idiomatic: After the rebellion was suppressed, he interrogated captured rebels and prosecuted those still at large; every innocent civilian who had been forced to join was released, saving a great many lives.

sentences.zh: 晚授桐柏，民苦盜，令村集建棚巡更，鄉數家出一人為門夫，有警環集，無事歸業。

translations.literal: Late in his career he was appointed to Tongbai; the people suffered from bandits, so he ordered village settlements to build watch-sheds for night patrols, with one gate-man supplied for every several households in a township; when there was an alarm they gathered in a ring, and when there was no trouble they returned to their occupations.
translations.idiomatic: Late in his career he was posted to Tongbai, where banditry was rampant. He ordered each village to erect patrol sheds and organize night watches, with one watchman contributed by every few households in each hamlet; at the first alarm they would rally together, and when all was quiet they went back to their work.

sentences.zh: 訪捕強暴者繩以法，積匪率遠徙。

translations.literal: He tracked down and arrested the violent and bound them by law; hardened bandits for the most part moved far away.
translations.idiomatic: He hunted down violent criminals and punished them according to law, and most of the entrenched outlaws moved far away.

sentences.zh: 慎於折獄，皆速結，訟日以稀。

translations.literal: He was careful in deciding cases; all were swiftly concluded, and lawsuits grew fewer day by day.
translations.idiomatic: He was meticulous in judging cases and brought them all to a swift conclusion, and day by day litigation grew rarer.

sentences.zh: 朔望蒞學，集諸生講論，增書院膏火，親課之如師。

translations.literal: On the first and fifteenth of each month he attended the school, gathered the students for discussion, increased the academy's lamp-oil funds, and personally instructed them like a teacher.
translations.idiomatic: On the first and fifteenth of each lunar month he visited the county school, assembled the students for lectures, increased funding for the academy, and personally examined them as a teacher would.

sentences.zh: 道光六年，邑人王四傑始登進士第，自明初以來所未有。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Daoguang, a native of the district, Wang Sijie, for the first time passed the jinshi examination — something not seen since the early Ming.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of the Daoguang reign (1826), a local man named Wang Sijie became the first person from the county ever to attain the jinshi degree — an achievement without precedent since the founding of the Ming.

sentences.zh: 募錢萬緡，建義學。

translations.literal: He raised ten thousand strings of cash and built charity schools.
translations.idiomatic: He raised ten thousand strings of copper cash and founded charity schools.

sentences.zh: 凡經塾三，蒙塾十五。

translations.literal: In all there were three classical schools and fifteen elementary schools.
translations.idiomatic: In all he established three schools for classical study and fifteen for elementary instruction.

sentences.zh: 擇其秀者入書院肄業，文教興而悍俗漸化。

translations.literal: He selected the most talented to enter the academy for study; culture and education flourished and fierce customs were gradually transformed.
translations.idiomatic: He chose the brightest students to pursue advanced study at the academy; as learning took root, the district's rough ways gradually softened.

sentences.zh: 在任十年，民安之。

translations.literal: He was in office ten years and the people were settled in peace.
translations.idiomatic: During his ten years in office the people lived in peace and contentment.

sentences.zh: 老病，大吏不令去，卒於官。

translations.literal: Old and ill, the high officials would not allow him to leave, and he died in office.
translations.idiomatic: When age and illness overtook him, his superiors refused to accept his resignation, and he died still in post.
